notes.title: Legend of Inn v0.5.1 update Notes
notes.content:
Legend of Inn v0.5.1 update Notes Optimized:
modify
1. Reworked the underlying game framework (there may be a lot of unexplained bugs, welcome to group 1150289553 feedback)
2. Categories are added to the Settings screen, and the zoom setting is added
3. Add black edges to all characters
4. Adjusted some interface details
5. Added automatic combat system of Douwu system (if automatic combat is enabled in Panlong Tower, it will automatically enter the next layer after 2 seconds of entering the settlement interface)
6. Modified the reading interface logic so that blank scenes are no longer displayed during scene switching
7. Optimized pathfinding initialization, now faster when switching scenes
8. The casino will now automatically place the previous bet before placing the bet, no more clicking to place the bet
9. Changed the logic of controlling the movement of the character, so that the movement of the main character will no longer be paused

BUG
1. Fixed some bugs where equipment was too large
2. Fixed an error in opening the climbing tower interface after dismissing a character with progress in the Climbing tower
3. Fixed the harmony BUG where Dragon Tower strikes without blood
4. Fixed a BUG where the screen would flash when climbing the tower to the next level
5. Fixed short text in the prompt box
6. Fixed a BUG where the Thor Halberd was incorrectly mapped
7. Fixed a BUG where the blood bar would not clear after a combat character was killed

notes.title: Inn legend V0.4.0 update instructions
notes.content:
Tales of Inns v0.4.0 update notes



System:

1. Rewrote the underlying framework (with the update of the game, more and more content, in order to more convenient development in the future, Kay Mimi replaced the underlying logic framework, may cause a series of strange bugs, but the speed of scene switching and the frame number in the middle and late game has also been significantly improved)

2. Added a matchmaker to propose marriage. At the matchmaker's place, you can buy tokens to propose marriage

3. You can propose to the character of 6 hearts, and get married in 3 days after the marriage proposal. You can unlock the family list and the related love games

4. After marriage, the child will get one medal if the intimacy reaches 100%. The child will grow up to be an adult three years later

5. Some weapons and equipment have been added



Functional:

1. Improved liking list

2. Marriageable characters now have 6 stars

3. Charisma attributes now provide an additional goodwill bonus to guided and attracted customers (led or attracted customers have more initial goodwill).

4. The charm bonus limit of the bed is now affected by the level of the inn. The maximum bonus of the 5 stars is 70 (last version was 60).

5. Increased the random attribute cap on the panel of Juxianlou Recruiters (it is now possible to recruit 500 blood cows)

6. Increased the number of items in the battle arena

7. Reduced the demand for 5 love feelings

8. You can press the left mouse button to confirm (strength bar and selection).

9. Clicking the next person on the personnel detail screen will no longer reset the entire screen

10. The skill list and book list now use the default ordering instead of learning time

11. The People list now has a "special" sort, which shows the special NPCs recruited

12. Combat list will now save the previously selected positions

13. Equipment and backpacks have been added to the sorting of items of specific types

14. Added the function of bed renaming (click the bed name in the bed list to rename the bed)

15. Reduced the chance of pedestrians sprouting mustaches

16. Favorites list now has Favorites Sort, Gift Sort, Conversation Sort



Sound effects:

1. Added a sound effect for opening doors

2. Added 2 music tracks to play during non-business hours

3. Added 1 combat sound

4. Added sound effects for hooligan fights



BUG:

1. Fixed an issue where the menu interface would not refresh the UI after completion of research

2. Fixes the BUG where the town lights are not lit at night when the arena and guild dispatches switch on the lights

3. Fixed a BUG where the end of battle sound did not end

4. Fixed text errors in promotion dispatches

5. Fixed an issue where the Settings button did not have sound effects

6. Fixed lens zooming and drag moving speed being too slow when open without locking frame

7. Fixed the BUG that the terrain pathfinding did not refresh on the day after the expansion of the inn

8. Fixed an issue where clicking on the UI would lead to a character in business

PS: If you still like this update, please give me a good comment. You can also join the discussion group 1150289553

notes.title: Inn legend V0.1.0 update instructions
notes.content:
I have been doing it silently for more than 2 weeks and finally updated it. So long! This update mainly updates the accommodation system on the 2nd floor, and optimizes the problem of low frame number when the traffic is large! More details are as follows





Second floor expansion:

Now the second floor extension can be carried out in the building workshop!



Accommodation System:

After the expansion of the 2nd floor, there will be customers in need of accommodation!



Bed customization:

Now the bed can be customized in the building workshop!



Stairs:

Now you can buy stairs-related items in the building workshop (Note: the stairs can only be used on the 2nd floor, and will automatically cover the decoration on the 1st floor after use)







Any other changes

1.BUG: Fixed 0 sales number in recipe statistics

2.BUG: Fixed an issue where opening a list of people would get stuck by clicking on items or details quickly

3. Passenger flow: Reduced the upper limit of the number of senior teams.

4. Customer flow: At present, three attributes of the inn will affect the generation interval of customers

5. Attendance: The presentation style of the attendance interface has been modified

6. People management: People management is now broken down into more responsibility options (some of the original responsibilities are invalid and need to be reset)

7. Accounting room: reduced the experience of each settlement of accounting room

8. Statistics: Now the completed and unfinished data of diners in the statistics have been counted separately (the completed data need to be re-counted from 0).

9. Statistics: Added statistics related to accommodation

10. Inn upgrade: Now the inn upgrade above the prefectural level has added the conditions related to accommodation upgrade

11. Rankings: Added lodging related rankings

12. Achievements: Add lodging related achievements

13. Aesthetic value: the upper limit of the aesthetic value of inns above the prefecture level has been raised

14. Favorable impression: fixed the favorable impression BUG where cream cake was added with 3

15.BUG: Fixed a BUG that could be moved during jump times

Calendar: fixed a BUG where the weather did not show on the first day of each month

17. Casino: The hero's fortune will now affect the guess size

18. Initial: The initial amount of money will now be 1000 COINS (original 500).

19. Settings: Added event stop acceleration Settings in Settings. You can cancel this setting if you do not want to cancel the acceleration when an event occurs.

20. Acceleration: 3 times acceleration is eliminated

21. Loans: The ceiling on loans has been increased

22. Fighting wu: Fixed some bugs in fighting Wu

23. Optimization: Optimized image loading and light and shadow effects (epic optimization for frames with large number of people, no longer jammed at 5x peak speed)



PS: If you still like this update to give a good comment ~ in addition can also add group 1150289553 discussion yo ~

PSS: After improving the accommodation system, the next big update will be that beauty salons can customize the appearance of NPC

notes.title: Tips before buying
notes.content:
Before you buy, there are some words about this game that I would like to say to my dear players and friends. If you can't accept the following spicy? It is not recommended to buy this game... (Developers don't recommend it, but it's ok...)

[B]1.[/b] At present, this game is still in semi-production. The main plot and friends' stories are basically not done, and there are only two big scenes.

[b]2.[/b] Because I am the only developer, due to limited energy, can not do everything, so there may be some puzzling bugs when playing, some game details may be relatively rough! But the follow-up will be gradually improved!

3.[/b] I haven't made the tutorial yet, but I may add it in the future, so it may be a little difficult to get started with the game at present... For details of the game play, you can go to the guild library to check the relevant Settings

[/b] [/b] The game was originally intended to be a Chinese small master inn management game, but it took a strange direction. Those who want to experience the luminescent dishes like little masters may be disappointed...

[B]5.[/b] The game is actually played down to the casual type, when you play, you don't have to be too impatient, slowly play on the line, all the content can be experienced.

[B]6.[/b] The content in the later period is a little bit free (gradually becomes magical...)



That's about it... ... ...
